Production fix: Scan → Query | Atomic UpdateCommand (no race conditions) | GSI DescribeTable on startup

Drives Live Village Map dashboard · Leaflet real-time overlay
Offline client sync logs during outages
security_audit_logs — PK: actor | SK: timestamp | TTL: none (retained indefinitely)
Access isolation — cross-actor scanning blocked | Admin action audit trail | DISHA 2023 compliance
Scan → Query: outbreak_telemetry.district-time-index + emergency_streams.district-date-index bounded queries
Dynamic districtId: getDistrictId(db, villageId) — Aurora join resolves real district before every DynamoDB write
Atomic UpdateCommand: patches only 4 owned fields — safe under concurrent writes; no PutCommand race conditions
GSI Validation: DescribeTableCommand on startup — compares required vs actual GSI names, fails loudly if missing
Idempotent TTL: ensureTTL() checks ENABLED|ENABLING state before calling — safe to re-run on every restart
PAY_PER_REQUEST billing — auto-scales to millions of writes per second with zero provisioning overhead
8 GSIs total | TTL active on 3 tables (outbreak_telemetry, village_node_state, sync_queues)
dynamoDB.endpoint: ap-south-1 | PAY_PER_REQUEST | Multi-AZ managed by AWS
DLQ: Failed events → capped 100-item JSON file | SSE broadcast to all admin sessions on outbreak
B2B /api/b2b/outbreaks endpoint scoped via districtId tenant from API key table
Verhoeff checksum validated before user Aadhaar stored in Aurora — no DynamoDB crossover for PII
3-attempt exp. backoff | Groq key = internal env
Transformer embedding model — powers SymptomNet DL
Multilingual — handles Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, EN, Hinglish
DIFFERENTIATOR 1 — OFFLINE-FIRST ONNX INFERENCE + 7-LANGUAGE VOICE I/O
Zero-connectivity clinical decision support + universal language accessibility
- ONNX SymptomNet runs in-browser — zero network needed
- IndexedDB queues submissions during signal outages
- SHA-256 local auth — works offline without server
- Demo Offline Login (pre-seeded cred hashes on first load)
- WHO Z-score + BP risk computed client-side (offline vitals)
- 7 languages natively: EN, Hindi, Hinglish, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali
- Voice-to-Text for non-literate rural users (Speech API)
- Canvas 16x16 pixel grid: skin tone, blur, blank validation
DIFFERENTIATOR 2 — B2B SCOPED API KEYS + NGO IMPACT ANALYTICS
Production-grade partner API tenancy + grant-proof reporting
- sk_live_* keys scoped to tenantId = districtId
- Middleware: x-api-key validated against api_keys table
- B2BUsageDashboard: per-tenant API calls + active keys view
- Risk Watchlist: high-risk pregnancies, overdue vaccinations
- Clean PDF export — district CMO monthly report
DIFFERENTIATOR 3 — AUTONOMOUS OUTBREAK AGENT (LAYER 1 — ACTIVE DETECTION)
Closed-loop AI agent — no human trigger — runs every 30 minutes
Every 30 min: OutbreakAgent queries Aurora symptom clusters → Groq Llama-3.3-70b (JSON mode, 3-attempt exp backoff)
If LLM confidence ≥ 70%: check DynamoDB 24h dedup → POST /api/admin/outbreak-alert → DynamoDB write → SSE broadcast → Live Map update
- AGENT_SECRET env guard — fails loudly at startup if missing
- Dynamic districtId: getDistrictId() Aurora join pre-write
- Atomic UpdateCommand (patches 4 fields, no race condition)
- Idempotent ensureTTL() — safe on every service restart
- Example: 5+ fever cases in one village within 24h
- SSE: Admin dashboard Outbreak Radar live update + reasoning
DIFFERENTIATOR 4 — PREDICTIVE VILLAGE RISK INTELLIGENCE (LAYER 2 — EARLY WARNING)
Forecasts elevated village risk BEFORE outbreaks begin — proactive, not reactive
Transparent weighted 4-signal engine — XAI contributor bars — Intervention Impact Forecast simulator
Output: Village Risk Score 0–100 | District-wide heatmap (GREEN → AMBER → RED)
Admin drilldown: XAI contributor bars + recommended prevention actions + intervention impact forecast simulator
ASHA/NGO Risk Forecast Tab: village score + health category flags + offline graceful fallback
SwasthAI Guardian Platform — Built for Bharat's villages, not just its cities — Devpost H0 Hackathon 2026 — Track: Monetizable B2B App
